criteria.title: The target file exists and parses as CSV
The sixteen-day grid is complete and regular
No missing value in the three area columns
Every area is physically possible and the sum adds up
Every step carries an ordered credible interval

criteria.detail: the early interval must be at least 30 per cent wider

criteria.title: Every step names sources that existed at the time

criteria.detail: must retain at least 60 per cent

criteria.title: Radar carries the vegetated class where it exists
criteria.measured: 16 of 16 radar-era years carry a radar step

criteria.title: A holdout validation exists with error in km2
Known recessions and refills appear in the right order
criteria.measured: 4 events tested against a median of 1204 km2

criteria.title: A provenance record names every input with a checksum
The builder reproduces the file exactly
